item.title: Brevyx
item.description:
In my view, it is normal for developers and engineers to slouch while working. Staring at the screen for a long time is going to strain your eyes. Sitting hours in front of a screen is quite normal among enthusiasts and hobbyist engineers, but isn’t healthy, is it?

We constantly worry about our apps being okay. But it is just as necessary to look after ourselves.

I tried out a few reminder systems, but their notification methods were disappointing.

item.title: Clipboard Manager
item.description:
I haven’t felt like going back to Windows since I switched to Ubuntu. But it was really annoying that there were no built-in clipboard history or a clipboard manager functionality in Ubuntu. That was one of the tools I used daily.

As a Software Engineer I always want to build something to use daily. I decided to build this one myself. By the help of Claude I started building this one. A simple, lightweight clipboard manager for Ubuntu. Which helps to copy, paste, organize, retrieve by search etc.
